patches.decision_note: Single-page content distribution and the position and steps of the How It Works section can change independently and require separate acceptance criteria.
The removed navigation linked sections of the short landing page, whereas the later header menu navigates to associated website pages; these behaviors have separate lifecycle and scope trajectories.

replacement.title: Sign-In Page Rough-Code Deliverable
replacement.definition: Provide rough implementation code for the additional Sign In page as a task-local executable handoff distinct from its persistent visual styling.

patches.decision_note: The rough-code request is an independently requested executable artifact and must not be folded into the Sign In page's visual-styling Requirement.

replacement.title: Provisioning Wizard Rough-Code Deliverable
replacement.definition: Provide rough implementation code for the Account Provisioning Wizard page as a task-local executable handoff distinct from its persistent visual styling.

patches.decision_note: The requested rough code is an executable deliverable that can be completed or withdrawn independently of the wizard's visual treatment.
The rough-code artifact is not a modification of persistent wizard styling and must be extracted under the separate coding-deliverable Requirement.

The client's statement that these pages only require a background, header logo, and possible footer supersedes the earlier detailed wizard-styling specification; stale specification and orientation keys must be removed.

value_updates.concurrent_panel_case: Determine an appropriate arrangement when shell and application panels are both present.

patches.decision_note: The source establishes the existing panels and the need to handle their concurrent presence, but it does not confirm the proposed opposite-side arrangement or unconditional concurrent-panel support.
